description: This file defines data structures and parsing logic related to the configuration of talk mode in an Android application, including handling JSON serialization/deserialization, and managing timeouts and session keys.

classes.name: TalkModeGatewayConfigState
classes.description: Data class representing the state configuration for talk mode, including session key, interruption flag, and silence timeout.

classes.name: TalkModeGatewayConfigParser
classes.description: Object containing a parser method to create TalkModeGatewayConfigState from JSON configuration.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JsonObject to produce a TalkModeGatewayConfigState instance, extracting session key, interrupt flag, and silence timeout.

methods.name: resolvedSilenceTimeoutMs
methods.description: Determines the silence timeout in milliseconds, falling back to a default if the provided JSON value is invalid.
